plugin.name: API connections
plugin.description: Saved API connections: an address, an authentication method and a secret kept in the keychain. Other plugins send requests through them.
field.secret.hint: Written to the keychain only; never shown again.
field.secret.hintBasic: Written to the keychain only: the password.
field.headers.placeholder: One per line: Name: value. Sent with every request.
note.host: Only the host of the address can be reached through this connection. Use :name in the address to override it per environment.
error.badUrl: The address must start with http:// or https://.
error.badPath: The path must stay on the connection's host.
error.noSecret: This authentication method needs a secret.
error.noAuthName: Give the header or parameter name.
error.badUsername: The Basic user name must not contain “:”.
